name: Crimson Apostle: Escape Room
detailed_description:
Just Updated

Our Steam page is live! Check it out, and get ready for early December when we’ll reveal updated screenshots and a gameplay trailer to bring the game’s experience to life!

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! 


Just Updated

At 32 Bits Studio, we continue working tirelessly on Crimson Apostle. Development is slow but steady. This week, we updated the Steam page art with improved artwork—hope you like it! And if you do, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!


About the Game

You can escape the horrors that lurk in the dark... but never the ones you carry inside.

Crimson Apostle is a narrative escape room set as a prequel to the novel Dracula. You play as Renfield, a man trapped between remorse and madness. To survive, you must solve puzzles, face disturbing visions, and overcome the trials imposed by the enigmatic Countess Dolingen of Gratz.

Explore the origins of the most unsettling character in the Dracula mythos and uncover the horrors that shaped his fate.

Main Features:

  • Solve intricate puzzles.

  • Investigate environments, solve riddles, and escape locked rooms using logic and observation.

  • Escape the visions that erode the protagonist’s sanity.

  • Flee from creatures that can interrupt puzzles at any moment.

  • Experience the origins of Dracula’s mythical servant. Discover how ambition and madness led him to his fate.

short_description: In this horror escape room, a prequel to the novel Dracula, you play as Renfield. Solve puzzles, survive the trials of the enigmatic Countess Dolingen of Gratz, and escape the horrors that haunt you — both outside and within your mind. Is your fate written in blood?

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5-4460, 2,70 Ghz or AMD FX-6300 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible (must support DirectX® 9.0c or higher)
  • Additional Notes: Hardware specification target 1080P/30FPS. May require reduction in Texture Quality settings and other settings adjustment.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 with 3GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible (must support DirectX® 9.0c or higher)
  • Additional Notes: Hardware specification target 1080P/60FPS
